editorial:
Imagine moving to Rome with a huge dream and a tiny bank account. You will meet five young women who all live together in one crowded apartment, trying to make it as actresses. It is a relatable look at that scary time in your early twenties when you have no steady job and your life feels like a mess, but you still believe you are going to be a star. The vibe is very grounded and real, showing you the stress of paying rent while waiting for a phone call from a casting director that might never come.

What really works here is how the movie captures the friendship and friction between the girls. You will see some great acting that makes these characters feel like people you actually know. While the pace is a bit slow at times, the honest dialogue keeps you interested. If you enjoy stories about chasing dreams against all odds, you should definitely give this a try. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a better bet for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing that the dream of fame is much harder than it looks. After many struggles and failed auditions, the girls realize that their bond is more important than a movie role. Some find small wins, while others have to face the reality that they might not make it. It ends on a bittersweet note, leaving you to wonder if they will stay in Rome or finally head home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and the struggle to find success in a big city.
